methods: First adapter attempt preserved: unsupported gamma/motion-blur camera attributes in CARLA 0.10.0. Use enumerated blueprint attributes and the Town10HD postprocess profile. A retained owned vehicle caused a subsequent preflight refusal; verified its ownership, destroyed it explicitly, and retained both failure logs.
Generate a separate all-black RGB test image and substitute only frames 150--164 in a derived input manifest; original RGB, LiDAR and native GNSS/IMU remain unchanged.

Synthetic native-sensor future perturbation after evaluation frame 149 leaves all first 150 ego frames exactly unchanged. An invalid scoring-truth file and read trap verify preprocessing never reads it.
Actual baseline/blackout YOLO-LiDAR output and estimator states (excluding timing) match exactly for the first 150 frames.
Scoring-only projection of truth target center into the camera checks selected boxes; no truth is fed back to prediction, no thresholds or gains are retuned.
Verified zero owned actors and sent SIGINT only to PID 2496204; process ended with signal exit 130. Port 2000 was not modified.

After the main runs, fix summary-only startup counts; actual three-frame YOLO/geometry rerun verifies filled=0, unresolved=3 and identical prediction prefix. Original main-run summaries preserved; both source hashes retained.
